linuxHelperScope: Authorize at installation: full hosts editing, low-port binding for built-in web servers as your user, Pure-Ftpd running as root, and repair of FlyEnv's PID directory. An existing FlyEnv public CA is also approved for system trust. Daily helper operations do not ask for a password. Reinstall here to approve a new CA; terminal sudo continues to use system authentication.
flyenvHelperInstallFailTips: FlyEnv helper installation failed. Keep using your original Windows account and retry with the helper repair button in Settings. If it fails again, share the error details below.
flyenvHelperInstallTimeout: Timed out waiting for the installation result. The installation may still be running in the background. Use the helper repair button again to check the result.
windowsElevationMethodTips: Choose how to authorize operations that cannot run with normal permissions. FlyEnv runs them directly when started as administrator.
appFontTips: Set the font used for the application UI. Leave empty to use the default system font
codeFontTips: Set the font used for terminal, editor and other code areas. Leave empty to use the default monospace font

windowsPrivilege.busy: Another authorization operation is in progress. Please wait.
windowsPrivilege.title: Choose an authorization method
windowsPrivilege.description: The operation “{operation}” needs administrator privileges. Choose how to authorize it.
windowsPrivilege.uacDescription: Windows UAC requests approval or administrator credentials when elevation is needed. No Helper installation is required. Operations that work with normal permissions run directly.
windowsPrivilege.helperDescription: Installs a background Helper run by a scheduled task to provide administrator privileges for supported operations. Installation or repair requires administrator authorization; later operations usually need no further approval.
windowsPrivilege.settingsHint: Your choice will be saved. You can change it later in Settings → Authorization Method.
windowsPrivilege.disableOption: Also disable any previously installed Helper for this account (may require UAC)
windowsPrivilege.disableOnSwitch: Switching to UAC automatically disables this account’s Helper. Installed files are kept.
windowsPrivilege.disableHelperTips: Stops the Helper installed for this Windows account and disables its scheduled task. Installed files are kept. This action may require UAC approval.
windowsPrivilege.disableFailed: Authorization is now UAC, but the existing Helper could not be disabled.
windowsPrivilege.elevated: Running as administrator: privileged operations run directly. This preference applies when running with normal permissions.
windowsPrivilege.unselected: No method selected. FlyEnv will ask when an operation first needs authorization.
windowsPrivilege.timeout: Windows authorization timed out. The action may still be completing.
